title: Limit Experiments for Missing-Outcome Means with Fallible Recall and Finitely Many Audits
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the delivered package subfield below the field floor (projected paper-score ceiling 6.7 < 7.4); no bounded salvage in scope, with two unrepaired proof-support findings.
gap_reasons: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field, target=field, NOT salvageable in scope.

missing-audit-survey-dependence-bound@thm:full-experiment — Gaussian Q is formed after removing audited R=0 units without a coupling/remainder for finite dependence on O(1) audited truth marks, so conditional-binomial Gaussianization alone does not establish the independent joint Gaussian-Poisson experiment or two-sided bound.

proof_attempt_summary: The final angle passed D-0.5 at field tier, and D0 constructed matched global rates, a mixed-source gain, and a proposed full Gaussian/marked-Poisson transfer. D0.5 graded the delivered package subfield because the finite-n 0.01 certificate was not executed or backed by an evaluable transfer modulus. Two proof-support gaps remain in the joint experiment and termination bound; no theorem was refuted.
tldr: Outcome-dependent EHR response leaves the missing-stratum outcome mean unidentified unless randomized recall or exact validation supplies information. The proposal studies the critical regime in which recall discrimination and response-specific drift are of order \(n^{-1/2}\), while only finitely many randomized gold audits arrive. Its field kernel is a two-sided equivalence between one coherently indexed finite triangular-array experiment and a baseline-indexed limit containing the regular structural Gaussian block, the full compact three-coordinate recall Gaussian block, and independent marked-Poisson truth audits. The focal decision target is the sharp honest connected-interval value \(\mathcal L_H(\alpha)\), with squared risk as a companion. Every unknown structural baseline sequence is an explicit compact root-\(n\) nuisance coordinate, and both finite values use one common kernel with a supremum over scientific and baseline parameters. Certified computation and the expanding-location contrast reduction are consequences, while a global rate theorem, its phase diagram, and an explicit two-arm all-procedure risk certificate establish design relevance.
gap: Published EHR double-sampling theory obtains true outcomes at follow-up and regular two-phase error-correction theory assumes enough validation for Gaussian efficiency. Neither treats fallible recall calibrated on responders, bounded transport drift, finitely many independent truth audits, zero-count faces, or sharp connected-interval decisions.
fill: The paper will prove the full two-sided experiment approximation from one causal triangular-array law indexed jointly by scientific and regular baseline coordinates, show convergence of exact finite-local values defined by common parameter-free kernels to the focal sharp mixed-experiment values, transfer observable exact-coverage procedures, establish the global rate envelope and its audit--recall phase diagram, certify strict mixed-source risk dominance on an explicit legal two-arm box, and derive computation and the center-free reduction as consequences.
